name: r1_arena_room_pet
note: R1 case D (BUGS #95). The fixture seeds a stage-7 tournament room whose A and B sides selected no pet. The scenario sends the stock PLAYOFFS_REQUEST_ROOM_INFO (1292) through xyd.Backend and hands the real reply to the stock sync_select_team window; its updateSelectHeroes -> updateSelfSelectPets indexes A_pet_info when the server sends null instead of omitting the key. Not a second device: the peer row and the room come from the provisioner fixture.
steps: lua:if vcDCode~=xyd.error.OK then error('vc-d-code-'..tostring(vcDCode)) end if type(vcDReply)~='table' then error('vc-d-reply') end xyd.WindowManager.get():openWindow('sync_select_team',vcDReply)
lua:local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('sync_select_team') if not w then error('vc-d-no-window') end w:updateSelectHeroes(vcDReply)
